info.name: cineMate — Recommendation Flow
info.description:
End-to-end test that proves the recommendation engine learns from review ratings.

Run order:
1. Auth — Register + Login (saves {{token}} and {{userId}})
2. Seed Movies — 7 movies the user will review + 4 extra unreviewed ones the engine can recommend
3. Browse Movies — sanity-check the data
4. Submit Reviews — Action/Sci-Fi rated high, Drama rated low
5. Get Recommendations — 5 strategies; results should favour Action/Sci-Fi
6. Interactions — click / dismiss a recommendation
7. History — view and clear history

item.name: 2. Seed Movies (Admin)
item.description:
Creates 11 movies via admin upsert (idempotent — safe to re-run).

Movies the user WILL review (7):
  Iron Storm, Urban Siege, Battle Front  — Action
  Void Protocol, Stellar Drift           — Sci-Fi
  The Quiet Room, Long Shadows           — Drama

Movies the user will NOT review (4 — these are what the engine recommends):
  Strike Force, Black Horizon            — Action  (same director/actors as above)
  Nexus, Gravity's Edge                  — Sci-Fi  (same director/actors as above)
  Funny Business                         — Comedy  (neutral)

All movie_ids are fixed UUIDs so upserts are deterministic.

Rates 7 movies by rating alone — the recommendation engine only uses the numeric rating, not review text.

  Action movies  → 4-5★  (strong like)

  Drama movies   → 1-2★  (dislike)

  Unreviewed movies (Strike Force, Black Horizon, Nexus, Gravity's Edge)
  share the same genres/actors/directors as the reviewed ones, so they
  are the expected candidates in folder 5.

item.name: 5. Get Recommendations
item.description:
What to expect after the reviews above:
  genres_based    → Strike Force, Black Horizon, Nexus, Gravity's Edge  (Action/Sci-Fi)
  actors_based    → movies with Ryan Mercer, Alex Torres, or Sophia Kane
  directors_based → movies by Marcus Cole or Elena Vasquez
  profile_based   → weighted mix of the above
  ai_model_based  → requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env (skipped gracefully if missing)
